# Marsden Auto Centre

Marsden Auto Centre is a collision repair and tyre centre at 470 Marsden Point Road, Ruakākā 0171, Northland. It was formerly Rowsells Collision Repair Centre; the location and phone remain the same.

Services include panel beating and accident repair, spray painting and colour matching, restoration, tyres, insurance repair coordination and automotive glass through Auto Mobile Glass.

Phone: 09 433 0313
Email: admin@marsdenautocentre.co.nz
Service area: Ruakākā, One Tree Point, Marsden Point, Waipū, Bream Bay, Whangārei, Mangawhai and Kaiwaka.
